nodes.label: Alerts Page — All Screens v7
nodes.description: Alerts module showing filter tabs: All 7, Unresolved 5 (active), Critical 2, Warning 3, Info 0. Alert list items with severity badges (critical/warning), resource type (server/database/website), timestamps, acknowledged state, and Acknowledge/Resolve action buttons. Example alerts: prod-worker-01 memory 91.7% (critical), prod-api-01 CPU 71.5% (warning/acknowledged), prod-postgres unreachable (warning), cobaltsystems.com degraded response (warning), legacy.orbitcloud.io down (critical).
